decisions.reason: The product remains a low-cost extension close to the established offer with no evidence of failure, so the option is kept open while uncertainty about its value resolves.
As a recently launched module building on the established offer, its prospects are still uncertain and keeping costs are low, so the option is retained.

Secure messaging is strategically tied to regulatory digital workflows and, although it demands more commitment, the option's potential value justifies keeping it open while adoption uncertainty resolves.
